bugClass: off-by-one / incomplete escape-run counting (only 1-2 backslashes handled, not parity of the full run)
bugSummary: Whether a quote was escaped was decided by jsonString[i-1]==='\\' && jsonString[i-2]!=='\\', which only handles runs of one or two backslashes; for a run of three or more it misjudges parity, so a string whose closing-context quote is escaped is treated as terminated and any // or /* inside it is wrongly stripped as a comment.
triggerInput: stripJsonComments(String.raw`{"x":"a\\\"//y"}`) (three backslashes before the quote, so it is escaped and the string continues): buggy strips the in-string `//y"}` as a comment; correct returns the input unchanged. Inputs with 0/1/2 backslashes agree.
